Reckelberg Environmental Technologies –
Innovating Battery Recycling

content.rendered:
When it comes to choosing advanced recycling technologies, Reckelberg Environmental Technologies stands out as a trusted leader in battery recycling innovation. With state-of-the-art equipment and a comprehensive suite of services, Reckelberg empowers customers to achieve sustainability and operational excellence in the rapidly growing circular economy.

As the exclusive partner of Reckelberg in North America, VAN DYK Recycling Solutions is proud to deliver their groundbreaking technologies and tailored services to customers across the region.

RET Technologies

Battery discharge

Reckelberg Environmental Technologies emphasizes the importance of fully discharging batteries before recycling to ensure operational and process reliability, as well as optimal product quality. All discharge technologies developed by Reckelberg are built on the latest and safest high-voltage discharge systems, designed specifically for lithium-ion battery storage units, modules, and cells. The system’s discharge capacity is customizable and capable of returning power from batteries to the local grid with high efficiency. This feature directly reduces energy consumption, such as in production and processes, while the fully discharged batteries significantly lower risks for employees and enhance the safety and efficiency of subsequent recycling processes.

Highlights:

  • For batteries from electric vehicles and stationary applications
  • Safety through deep discharge down to 0 volts
  • Efficient energy recovery thanks to bidirectional design
  • Freely selectable discharge depth of up to 1,000 V

Vacuum drying

Reckelberg Environmental Technologies provides the ideal foundation for achieving top-quality black mass through the low-emission recovery of electrolytes. The company’s advanced vacuum drying technology enhances both the safety and environmental sustainability of recycling processes while significantly improving cost efficiency and material recovery. By incorporating this innovative system, businesses can maximize the reuse of valuable raw materials, reduce operational costs, and strengthen their competitive position in the market.

Highlights:

  • Safety: Safe and low-emission recovery of volatile organic electrolytes
  • Quality: Low temperatures in the vacuum dryer ensure high-quality black mass
  • Fire risk minimization: The drying process drastically reduces the fire risk in the further treatment
  • Increased efficiency: Efficient processing and material recovery, e.g. through parallel redundant drying

Impact reactor: front runner in battery recycling

The RET Impact Reactor represents the future of material recovery, combining exceptional performance with outstanding material quality. Designed to meet the highest standards of quality and sustainability, this state-of-the-art technology leads its class in delivering superior black mass quality. By transforming recycling processes, the Impact Reactor sets new industry benchmarks for advanced, environmentally friendly solutions. Reckelberg Environmental Technologies understands the industry’s demands and the critical need for sustainable innovation. The Impact Reactor not only boosts productivity but also contributes to conserving the planet’s resources, redefining what is possible in modern recycling.

Highlights:

  • Quality: Highest purity and quality of the recovered black mass
  • Recovery: Highest yield of valuable metal fractions
  • Safety: Integrated separation of hazardous substances in powder form and robust design
  • Insensitivity: The geometry of the Impact Reactor makes it particularly insensitive to impurities

Driving the Future of Recycling Together

The partnership between VAN DYK Recycling Solutions and Reckelberg Environmental Technologies brings world-class battery recycling technology to customers in America. Together, we deliver systems and services that empower recyclers to achieve their goals efficiently, sustainably, and profitably.
